subject: E-2148: cannot write data directory on Windows
body:
Good morning. My setup is LedgerLine 9.1.3, Windows 11 23H2. Starting last week, the moment I open
the app a dialog reads 'E-2148: cannot write to data directory'.

This began right after the operating system upgrade last weekend. I suspect an access prompt was
dismissed while the upgrade ran.

What I tried so far: closing every other program. No luck.

Regards, Priya Nair, Halden Logistics
